name: 英语
description: 习百家言语，通天地之道。

chapters.name: 时态与语态
chapters.summary: 时态体系与被动语态的转换规律。

knowledge.name: 动词时态
examples: She has finished her homework.
By the time we arrived, the film had started.
knowledge.tips: 注意时间状语与时态的对应

knowledge.name: 被动语态
examples: The book was written by him.
The bridge is being repaired.
knowledge.tips: 强调动作承受者时用被动

chapters.name: 三大从句
chapters.summary: 定语从句、名词性从句、状语从句的引导词选择。

knowledge.name: 定语从句
examples: The man who is standing there is my teacher.
This is the city where I was born.
commonMistakes: 非限制性从句逗号缺失
knowledge.tips: 分析先行词在从句中的成分

knowledge.name: 名词性从句
examples: That he will win is certain.
I don't know whether she will come.
knowledge.tips: 判断从句在句子中的成分

knowledge.name: 状语从句
points: 时间条件原因让步等类型
examples: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
Although he was tired, he kept working.

chapters.name: 非谓语与虚拟语气
chapters.summary: 非谓语动词与虚拟语气的用法。

knowledge.name: 非谓语动词
examples: To learn English well takes time.
Swimming is good exercise.
knowledge.tips: 判断逻辑主语与动词关系

knowledge.name: 虚拟语气
examples: If I were you, I would study harder.
I wish I had come earlier.

chapters.name: 词法与句法
chapters.summary: 倒装强调、情态动词、连词介词、主谓一致与冠词代词。

knowledge.name: 倒装与强调
examples: Never have I seen such a view.
It was Tom who broke the window.
commonMistakes: 强调句型与主语从句混淆
knowledge.tips: 否定词置于句首常需部分倒装

knowledge.name: 情态动词
examples: He must be at home now.
You must have seen him.
knowledge.tips: 情态动词后面接动词原形

knowledge.name: 连词与介词
examples: Both Tom and Mary are students.
He works hard so that he can succeed.

knowledge.name: 主谓一致与冠词代词
examples: The news is interesting.
He is an honest boy.
knowledge.tips: 就近原则与意义一致原则

chapters.name: 词汇与短语
chapters.summary: 高频词汇、短语动词与词形变化。

knowledge.name: 高频核心词汇
examples: 词根词缀记忆法
高频词汇辨析

knowledge.name: 短语动词与词形变化
examples: look after/take off等短语
名词动词形容词的转化
knowledge.tips: 短语动词含义需积累记忆

chapters.name: 阅读与完形填空
chapters.summary: 阅读理解技巧与完形填空语境推断。

knowledge.name: 阅读理解
examples: 根据上下文猜测词义
推断作者态度

knowledge.name: 完形填空
examples: 根据语境选择恰当词汇
七选五的衔接词
knowledge.tips: 完形填空注重上下文呼应

chapters.name: 写作与听力
chapters.summary: 应用文写作、书面表达与听力理解。

knowledge.name: 写作与书面表达
examples: 书信、通知、申请信写作
续写与概要写作

knowledge.name: 听力理解
